source: Official Q1 FY27 earnings-call transcript (16 pages) + company filing
text: HDFC Bank reported standalone net profit of Rs 19,060 crore for Q1 FY27, up 5% year-on-year but below the street estimate of Rs 19,332 crore. Net interest income grew 7% to Rs 33,536 crore, also below the estimate of Rs 34,353 crore. On the earnings call, CEO Sashidhar Jagdishan said: 'we navigated during this period certain challenges over the last four months... deposit growth continues to be relatively better than the historical Q1 trends. We continue to gain market share both on an incremental basis and on a stock basis as well.' Asked whether margins have bottomed out, CFO Srinivasan Vaidyanathan replied that 'the cost of funds is the biggest opportunity on the margin... there can be 40, 50 basis points change, but it is not going to change in a hurry.' Net interest margin stood at 3.4%, down from 3.5% last quarter. Asset quality stayed strong with GNPA at 1.17%, down from 1.40% a year ago. Advances grew 15%, ahead of the banking system. Shares fell 5.1% on the next trading session.

source: Official Q1 FY27 media release + analyst webcast (ril.com)
text: Reliance reported consolidated revenue of Rs 340,257 crore for Q1 FY27, up 24.5% year-on-year, with record recurring EBITDA of Rs 54,067 crore, up 10.1%. Net profit attributable to owners was Rs 20,946 crore, down 22% from Rs 26,994 crore a year ago, but beat the street estimate of Rs 19,823 crore. The year-ago quarter had included a one-time gain of Rs 8,924 crore from asset sales. Chairman Mukesh Ambani said: 'Reliance has made a steady start to FY27, with all businesses delivering strong operating performance... demonstrated its resilience in a quarter which witnessed continuing geopolitical tensions and volatile commodity markets.' He added that Jio Platforms has filed its DRHP with SEBI, 'a significant step towards its public listing', that Reliance Retail 'delivered resilient growth this quarter', and that he is 'confident that it is well placed to benefit from long term consumption growth'. Jio ended June with 533.3 million subscribers after adding 8.9 million during the quarter. EBITDA margin compressed to 15.4% from 17.6% a year ago.

source: Official Q1 FY27 earnings-call transcript + company press release
text: Infosys reported revenue of Rs 48,211 crore for Q1 FY27, up 14% year-on-year and 2.4% in constant currency. Net profit was Rs 7,769 crore, up 12% year-on-year. CEO Salil Parekh said on the call: 'Our revenue growth for Q1 was 2.4% year-on-year and 1% quarter-on-quarter in constant currency terms. We had a onetime revenue impact of a client decision during this quarter. Our AI services revenue was 8.2% of overall revenue. Our large deals were $3.6 billion with a net new of 61%. Our operating margin was 21.1%.' Operating margin expanded to 21.1%, up 20 bps sequentially. CFO Jayesh Sanghrajka added there was a 'one-off 50 basis point impact on account of program termination' by a client and that 'volumes were soft'. The company cut its full-year revenue growth guidance to 1.5% to 3% from 1.5% to 3.5%, citing macro uncertainty, while operating margin guidance stays at 20% to 22%. Large deal wins were strong at $3.6 billion, 61% net new. The ADR fell 5% after results.
